decision: A Reprimand is issued to the driver of Car 77 Valtteri Bottas. (1st reprimand of the current season)
event_name: Document 23 Date 25 August 2018 Time 14:27 2018 BELGIAN GRAND PRIX 23 - 26 August 2018 The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (documents 18 & 19) and heard the drivers and team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 77 was driven in a manner that was potentially dangerous to the driver of Car 2 between turns 4 and 5.
offence: Breach of Article 27.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: A Reprimand is issued to the driver of Car 77 Valtteri Bottas. (1st reprimand of the current season)
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and radio evidence, heard from the driver of car 77 (Valtteri Bottas), the driver of car 2 (Stoffel Vandoorne) and the team representatives. The driver of car 77 conceded the incident was his fault and that he had not seen car 2 approaching, despite checking his mirrors and having heard a warning message from his team. He believed that car 2 was further behind than it actually was. The Stewards determined the incident was not intentional or reckless and for this reason imposed the penalty referred to above.
rules_referenced: Article 27.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Doc 23 2018 Belgian Grand Prix Offence Car 77 Incident With Car 2
